title: Email Engine — Skill-44 (Convert & Flow / GoHighLevel) DRAFT-ONLY deploy build plan
description: The P4 handoff contract emitted by tools/emit_build_plan.py and consumed by `caf workflows build --from-plan`. Scope is workflow EMAIL steps only (NOT GHL Campaigns/Broadcasts or reusable Email Builder templates). Every workflow is built as a DRAFT; nothing sends until a human approves. Shape mirrors 44-.../utils/workflow_builder.py email_step() + validate_campaign().

folder.description: The GHL folder the draft workflow(s) land in.

_meta.description: Optional provenance: source brief/sequence ids, deploy_mode='draft-only', generated_at, generator. When 'profile' names the Signature Launch profile (signature_launch_landing_10), the extended handoff fields below are REQUIRED (spec 13 section 7): approved content hashes, variant strategy, source/target ids, enrollment conditions, timing anchors, lifecycle stop/suppression rules and sender configuration references. Credential values must never appear in a plan; sender configuration is carried as named references only.

draft_only.description: Always true. The plan builds DRAFT workflows only; nothing sends.

profile.description: Named email profile, e.g. signature_launch_landing_10. Absent on legacy plans.

canonical_fields.description: The email fields the per-email hash covers, in canonical form (JSON, sorted keys, authored list order).

per_email.description: Map of 'E<slot>' to the sha256 hex digest of that email's approved content.

sequence.description: sha256 over the ordered per-email hashes.

variant_strategy.description: How subject/preview variants travel: explicit pairs (A with A, B with B), never a flattened unpaired list. Testing uses a verified native split-test capability or an approved alternative; unsupported testing is a reported gap, never a dropped pair.

source_ids.description: Producer-side ids: sequence id, profile, brief sequence position.

target_ids.description: Consumer-side ids: Skill 44 workflow slug/name and draft mode.

anchor_event.description: The event every offset is measured from (e.g. enrollment), never chained off a previous send.

timezone_ref.description: Named reference to the consumer's location timezone; not a credential.

suppression_rules.description: Must include promotion suppression after a verified purchase and an eligibility recheck immediately before each scheduled send. Skill 44 owns enforcement.

sender_config_refs.description: Named sender configuration REFERENCES only (for example 'sender-config:default'), resolved by Skill 44 against its own configuration. Credential values are forbidden anywhere in the plan.

status.description: Always 'draft' — Skill 50 NEVER emits a published workflow. Human approval + Skill-44 qc-built-workflow.sh (>=8.5) precede any publish.

templates.description: Ordered workflow steps (email + wait). Each carries a unique id, a type, and a name.

slot.description: Email steps only, Signature Launch profile: the email's slot in its sequence.

content_hash.description: Email steps only, Signature Launch profile: sha256 of the email's approved content (subjects, previews, body, ctas); must equal _meta.content_hashes.per_email for this slot.

variant_pairs.description: Email steps only, Signature Launch profile: EXPLICIT subject/preview pairs. Pair A is subject A + preview A; Pair B is subject B + preview B. Two testable pairs, never a flattened unpaired preview list; the legacy flat 'ab' block must not appear on a paired step.
